tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Returns a previously run audit by its id (the last part of a tools.roasexpert.com/r/<id> or /p/<id> link). Locked reports show the top three issues and check statuses; unlocked reports show every finding with its fix and the written summary. Reports are kept for 90 days. No usage limit.

tools.name: unlock_report
tools.description: Unlocks a report: every failing and warning check with its detail and the fix written for the detected platform, plus the written summary. tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: The catalogue of checks the audit runs, grouped by category with weights and a one-line description of what passes. Use it to explain a score or to see what the audit covers. No usage limit.

tools.name: explain_fix
tools.description: Returns the fix text for one check id (from list_checks, a site report or a product page report) written for a platform: shopify, wordpress, magento, framer, webflow, wix, squarespace, bigcommerce, hubspot, nextjs or generic. No usage limit.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_site, audit_product_page, get_report, unlock_report · Public sink: audit_site, audit_product_page, unlock_report · Destructive: get_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_site, audit_product_page, get_report, unlock_report · Public sink: audit_site, audit_product_page, unlock_report · Destructive: get_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_report" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
